![](images/7f/7f05c2f205b6ca3dd94bbe73f47dde73471ac25817381beb56431231f7ffe4dd.png)

Find the area of $△ABC$. Round your answer to two decimal places.

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
corrected_content.worked_solution: The sides adjacent to the $20^\circ$ angle are $5$ and $13$. The triangle area is $$\frac12(5)(13)\sin20^\circ\approx11.11565466.$$ Rounded to two decimal places, the area is $11.12$.
